aub_can_upgrade_to_city_02_trigger = {
	# vanilla can_construct_potential
	building_requirement_tribal = no
	# vanilla can_construct
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = next_level_cities
				}
			}
		}
		culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_manorialism
		}
	}
	trigger_else = {
		culture = {
			has_cultural_parameter = next_level_cities
		}
	}
}
